info.name: Tendwell API - R1.1 regression (synthetic data)
info.description: Business-rule API checks for Tendwell R1.1 against the staging environment. Synthetic data only; load the seed in 06-quality/test-data (data as of 2026-09-15T08:30:00-04:00), then pin the TEN-001 and TEN-003 virtual clocks to 2026-09-15T08:55:00-04:00 before running. Request bodies are copied from test-data/api-fixtures.json. Reset the seed after each run because the run creates punches, invoices and audit events. Run order matters: Auth first.

item.name: Clients
item.description: PHI masking, duplicate detection, audited reveal and authorization utilization. Runs as Marcus Hale (AG-COORD, Lakemont North).

exec: pm.test('C-10234 is listed for Lakemont North', () => pm.expect(c).to.be.an('object'));
pm.test('No Lakemont South client leaks to a North-scoped coordinator (FR-IAM-06)', () => pm.expect(b.items.map(i => i.clientNumber)).to.not.include.members(['C-10295', 'C-10333', 'C-10347']));

item.name: Create client - possible duplicate requires confirmation (C-10301)

request.description: TC-CLI-002, US-012-AC3. No client is created until the coordinator confirms.

exec: pm.test('Message is human-readable, no raw code in detail (NFR-USE-03)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.be.a('string').and.not.include('CLI_POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE'));
pm.test('Matched existing client is named', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().matches.map(m => m.clientNumber)).to.include('C-10301'));
pm.test('Match reason is name and date of birth', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().matches[0].matchedOn).to.include.members(['firstName', 'lastName', 'dateOfBirth']));
pm.test('Only the requested field is returned in clear', () => { pm.expect(b.field).to.eql('medicaidId'); pm.expect(b.value).to.eql('ZZ48105522'); });
pm.test('PA-2026-55871 is Active T1019 Hourly', () => { pm.expect(a.status).to.eql('Active'); pm.expect(a.serviceCode).to.eql('T1019'); pm.expect(a.billingModel).to.eql('Hourly'); });
pm.test('No utilization or expiry alert', () => pm.expect(a.alerts).to.eql([]));

item.name: EVV
item.description: Run with the tenant virtual clock pinned to 2026-09-15T08:55-04:00 (clock-in opens 08:45 for the 09:00 visits). TEN-001 has identity verification On, so each clock-in consumes a fresh identity check.

item.name: Clock-in at 212 m - LOCATION_MISMATCH, punch accepted

exec: pm.test('Status is 201 (punch never blocked for location)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.test('Server computed 212.0 m and ignored device distanceM (BR-021)', () => pm.expect(b.punch.distanceM).to.eql(212.0));
pm.test('No LOW_GPS_ACCURACY for an 18 m fix', () => pm.expect(b.exceptions.map(e => e.code)).to.not.include('LOW_GPS_ACCURACY'));
pm.test('Device time and server receipt time kept separately', () => { pm.expect(b.punch.punchTime).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.punch.receivedAt).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: Payroll
item.description: Canonical E-2041 Labor Day week (US-041) and period locking. Uses finToken (AG-FIN, injected by CI).

exec: const line = t => cg.lines.find(l => l.lineType === t);

pm.test('Holiday 6 hours at 2925 cents = 17550 cents', () => { const x = line('Holiday'); pm.expect(x.quantity).to.eql(6.0); pm.expect(x.rateCents).to.eql(2925); pm.expect(x.amountCents).to.eql(17550); });

pm.test('Regular 31.5 hours at 1950 cents = 61425 cents', () => { const x = line('Regular'); pm.expect(x.quantity).to.eql(31.5); pm.expect(x.rateCents).to.eql(1950); pm.expect(x.amountCents).to.eql(61425); });

pm.test('Travel 2.5 hours at 1950 cents = 4875 cents', () => { const x = line('Travel'); pm.expect(x.quantity).to.eql(2.5); pm.expect(x.rateCents).to.eql(1950); pm.expect(x.amountCents).to.eql(4875); });

pm.test('Overtime 3 hours at 2925 cents = 8775 cents', () => { const x = line('Overtime'); pm.expect(x.quantity).to.eql(3.0); pm.expect(x.rateCents).to.eql(2925); pm.expect(x.amountCents).to.eql(8775); });

pm.test('Mileage 46.2 miles at 70 cents = 3234 cents', () => { const x = line('Mileage'); pm.expect(x.quantity).to.eql(46.2); pm.expect(x.rateCents).to.eql(70); pm.expect(x.amountCents).to.eql(3234); });
pm.test('Mileage reimbursement 3234 cents is not wages', () => pm.expect(cg.totals.reimbursementCents).to.eql(3234));
pm.test('Message is human-readable, no raw code in detail (NFR-USE-03)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.be.a('string').and.not.include('PAY_PERIOD_LOCKED'));
pm.test('Points to the next open period for adjustments (BR-046)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().nextOpenPeriodId).to.be.a('string'));
